title: Microsoft 365 sign-in and MFA
summary: Use when a person cannot access Microsoft 365 or is repeatedly prompted to authenticate.
steps: Confirm the affected user and scope; do not request passwords.
Verify the user can reach the approved sign-in page.
Ask the identity administrator to check account lock and sign-in logs.
Have the user complete MFA and remove only their own stale client credentials.
Escalate to identity support if the issue persists after a clean sign-in.

title: DNS resolution failure
summary: Use for hostnames that cannot be resolved or services unreachable by name.
steps: Confirm the hostname and expected network/VPN context.
Run a read-only DNS lookup against an approved hostname.
Compare the result with the documented expected record.
Check the local network or VPN connection.
Escalate record changes to the network team; do not change DNS from this application.

title: Web application unavailable
summary: Use when an internal or public web page/API returns an error or times out.
steps: Record the URL, time, error code, and user impact.
Perform a read-only HTTP status check against an approved endpoint.
Check the service status page and recent deployment records.
Compare with a known-good endpoint if available.
Page the service owner if impact is broad or a P1/P2 threshold is met.

title: VPN connectivity problem
summary: Use for remote workers unable to reach internal services.
steps: Confirm whether the issue affects one user or multiple users.
Ask the user to reconnect and complete the normal MFA flow.
Verify their local internet connection without collecting sensitive data.
Check the approved VPN status page.
Escalate to the network team if there is evidence of a broader outage.
